fr.semantic_evidence: Project ID is ID du projet, not authorization code. compte de service JSON/path alternatives preserved. Enter à vide and Esc cancel connexion; narrow no-break spaces before semicolon and colon, final input-separating space preserved.

es.semantic_evidence: Project ID and authorization code remain distinct. cuenta de servicio and ruta del archivo JSON preserve alternatives. Enter sin texto cancels inicio de sesión, not a skip. Tú-register Introduce/deja is consistent.

zh-CN.semantic_evidence: 项目ID, not authorization code; 服务账号JSON或JSON文件路径 retains both input forms. 留空按Enter或按Esc取消登录 explicitly cancels. 请输入 is correct field-prompt register; no interscript spaces per guide; full-width punctuation.

ru.semantic_evidence: Идентификатор проекта clearly names project identifier, not auth code. JSON сервисного аккаунта или путь к JSON-файлу retains raw JSON/path alternatives. Enter без ввода или Esc отменить вход clearly cancels. Введите/оставьте is polite plural imperative.

vi.semantic_evidence: ID dự án is project ID; JSON của tài khoản dịch vụ hoặc đường dẫn tệp JSON preserves alternatives. để trống rồi nhấn Enter hoặc nhấn Esc để hủy đăng nhập cancels whole login. Natural direct pronoun-free copy, NFC and hủy spelling follow guide.

ur.semantic_evidence: Google Cloud پروجیکٹ ID identifies project, not auth code. سروس اکاؤنٹ کا JSON یا JSON فائل کا پاتھ preserves raw JSON/path distinction. hint means Enter sends and empty Enter or Esc cancels login, not optional skip. درج کریں/چھوڑیں/دبائیں are respectful; text stored in logical order; Latin tokens intact, no embedded bidi controls or arrows. In the standard coordinated imperative construction, خالی چھوڑ کر modifies the Enter alternative; Esc remains a cancellation key. Visual terminal bidi/shaping not inferred from storage.

hi.semantic_evidence: Google Cloud प्रोजेक्ट ID identifies project, not auth code. सेवा खाते का JSON या JSON फ़ाइल का पाथ preserves raw JSON/path alternatives. Empty Enter or Esc cancels लॉगिन, not skip. दर्ज करें/छोड़ें/दबाएँ are polite; फ़ाइल nukta and danda preserved.
